finalContracts: Guided Help management has independent global and Agency permissions, without Program scope or record-assignment authority.
Source drafts may be incomplete; publication requires bilingual complete content and host-compatible registered screens, controls and journeys.
Source publication and Agency audience publication are separate immutable-version lifecycles. Saving draft settings does not change the live audience.
Agency adoption pins a published source version. New source versions require explicit selection and Agency publication.
Retired or unshared sources do not remove already-retained Agency versions. Agency unpublish stops new discovery; source copies remain independent.
Discovery and launch require current screen access plus an active published audience role, and launch rechecks eligibility.
Preview uses real business controls and can change live data; the authoring guide states this beside preview instructions.
Branches compare registered choice or boolean fields in order, support a fallback or end, and require forward destinations. Reader Previous follows actual history.
Progression follows successful trusted actions, not raw clicks, and preserves accepted evidence during loading and unrelated Help dialogs.
Risk workflow journeys bind the selected Agency Agreement and exact execution tasks, provide recovery for wrong record/task, and never complete business work by finishing instructions.
Tab-local sessions pin source content and progress to the user, validate restored paths, clear on exit/logout/user change, and fall back to memory when storage is blocked.
Management and Administration group permitted sidebar entries; theme toggle replaces the outdated documented bell button.

Host shared diagrams support branch layout, zoom 25-200 percent, full-window keyboard recovery, complete SVG export and 4x PNG export independent of zoom/pan. Public extension diagram contract remains read-only.
